sum: Jaypee Infra Ventures has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) triggering substantial acquisition or triggering takeover code notification requirements in listed entity Jaiprakash Associates Limited, signalling a material change in shareholding or control intent.
detail: Jaypee Infra Ventures Private Limited submitted a mandatory disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is triggered when an acquirer crosses 25% shareholding or announces intent to acquire 20%+ voting rights, requiring public announcement and open offer mechanics. The specific shareholding percentage, acquisition value, timeline for open offer, and any conditions precedent are contained in the full disclosure document filed with the exchange.
